# Photographic-style city environments

Three generated fantasy-environment atlases, encoded as WebP for delivery. Each contains four photographic-style scenes in a 2×2 grid. CSS crops each quadrant independently at its original aspect ratio with small overscan to exclude neighboring cells.

- city-a: capital, market, homes, gardens
- city-b: festival, workshop, academy, forest
- city-c: forgotten quarter, court, library, realistic treehouse exterior

The existing ../interiors images provide indoor scenes, including the furnished owl treehouse. Original generated PNGs are retained in the authoring workspace.
